sports.h3: Russell holds off Verstappen by 0.196s in chaotic Baku race
sports.summary: George Russell won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on Saturday 26 September from pole, beating Max Verstappen by 0.196 seconds after two safety cars and six retirements.
body: George Russell converted pole into his third win of 2026 at the Baku City Circuit, crossing the line just under two tenths ahead of a charging Max Verstappen. Isack Hadjar completed a Red Bull double podium in third, with Charles Leclerc fourth and championship leader Kimi Antonelli fifth after recovering from 16th on the grid.

The race turned on two safety car periods, first after Alex Albon crashed his Williams and then after Franco Colapinto locked up at Turn 1 on a restart and took out Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris. Oscar Piastri ran in the podium places for most of the afternoon but a lock-up dropped him to 14th, leaving McLaren without points.

Russell had qualified on Friday with a 1:42.526, a margin of 0.837s over Leclerc that he called the biggest of his career. Antonelli had clipped the Turn 1 wall in Q1 and could not continue, while Verstappen started eighth after a power unit issue limited his running.

sports.h3: Norris calls for race ban after Colapinto's Turn 1 pile-up
sports.summary: Lando Norris said Franco Colapinto deserves at least a one-race ban after the Alpine driver's restart lock-up in Baku eliminated himself, Gasly and Norris.
body: Colapinto locked both fronts entering Turn 1 on a safety car restart while running tenth and slid into team-mate Pierre Gasly, with the chain reaction also ending Norris's race. The Argentine apologised on the radio and to the media, saying he was completely out of control.

Norris argued the FIA should hand out bans for careless driving, noting his damaged parts were now scrap. Under the current penalty points system a ban requires 12 points in 12 months, and Colapinto sits on only four, so a suspension looks unlikely.

The stewards gave Colapinto a 10-second penalty that will become a grid drop for the next round in Sepang because he did not finish. Alpine lost at least seven points it had been holding and said it would consider what action to take internally.

sports.h3: Hadjar's return delivers Red Bull's first double podium since 2024
sports.summary: Isack Hadjar finished third behind Verstappen in Baku, giving Red Bull its first double podium since 21 April 2024 in his first race back from injury.
body: Hadjar had not qualified since the Hungarian Grand Prix but lined up fourth in Baku and ran a clean race to third. He described it as the first time he had put together a tidy weekend with the senior team, and he managed the team dynamics well when Verstappen closed in behind him.

Verstappen said that even from a front-row start Russell's pace would have been hard to beat, but the result showed Red Bull as a genuine contender despite a power unit deficit. Elsewhere Haas scored with both cars for the first time in months, while both Aston Martins retired with separate technical problems.

sports.h3: Alcaraz saves two match points as Europe leads Laver Cup 7-5
sports.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beat Taylor Fritz 6-3, 4-6, 13-11 on Saturday in London, and a Ruud and Zverev doubles win put Team Europe 7-5 up going into Sunday's final day.
body: Team World dominated the Saturday day session at The O2. Alex de Minaur came back to beat Alexander Zverev 2-6, 7-6(5), 11-9 after Zverev wasted a match point, and Learner Tien edged Flavio Cobolli 6-3, 2-6, 10-7 on his Laver Cup debut.

Alcaraz, playing his first singles match since his US Open quarter-final loss to Ben Shelton, saved Fritz's first match point with an ace and the second with a drop shot before winning on his third chance. Fritz made only nine unforced errors to Alcaraz's 30, but the Spaniard hit 42 winners to 20.

Casper Ruud and Zverev then beat Alexander Bublik and Brandon Nakashima 6-4, 7-6(7) in doubles. Sunday matches are worth three points each and the first team to 13 wins; the final day is scheduled for later today.

sports.h3: Jodar and Ruud put Europe 3-1 ahead on Laver Cup opening day
sports.summary: Team Europe won three of four matches on Friday 25 September at The O2, with Rafael Jodar beating Bublik 6-2, 6-3 and Alcaraz and Mensik taking the doubles.
body: Casper Ruud opened the event by recovering from a set down to beat Francisco Cerundolo 6-7(4), 6-4, 10-8. Brandon Nakashima claimed Team World's only point of the day by beating Jakub Mensik 6-1, 3-6, 10-7.

Rafael Jodar dismissed Alexander Bublik in straight sets before Carlos Alcaraz and Mensik beat Bublik and Taylor Fritz 6-4, 6-4 in the night-session doubles. The event is back at The O2 four years after Roger Federer played his final match there, and Federer watched from the front row over the weekend.

sports.h3: Rybakina tops China Open seeds as draw is made today
sports.summary: New world No. 1 and US Open champion Elena Rybakina is top seed for the WTA 1000 China Open, which runs 30 September to 11 October; the draw takes place Sunday 27 September.
body: Beijing will be Rybakina's first event as world No. 1 after she overtook Aryna Sabalenka with her US Open title run. Sabalenka is second seed, followed by Jessica Pegula, Coco Gauff and Mirra Andreeva, with Amanda Anisimova defending the title as 11th seed.

Victoria Mboko, Alex Eala and Madison Keys have withdrawn from the 96-player draw, with Eala representing the Philippines at the Asian Games instead. Emma Raducanu is also out as she recovers from a stress fracture, and former world No. 4 Zheng Qinwen has a wildcard.

sports.h3: Gakpo stunner earns 1-1 draw with Germany in Xavi's debut
sports.summary: Cody Gakpo volleyed in a stoppage-time equaliser on Thursday 24 September as the Netherlands drew 1-1 with Germany in the Nations League in Xavi's first game in charge.
body: Felix Nmecha put Germany ahead in the first half while Brian Brobbey was down injured, sparking fury from Virgil van Dijk and the home side because the visitors played on. Van Dijk had earlier had a header ruled out after a VAR review, and debutant Mexx Meerdink also had a goal chalked off after the break.

Substitute Ruben van Bommel, making his debut, crossed with the outside of his right foot and Gakpo finished at the far post in the 92nd minute. Xavi switched Oranje to a back four and a high press, and the performance after the interval drew broad praise. A minute's silence was held before kick-off for Bartina Koeman, wife of former coach Ronald Koeman.

sports.h3: Oranje face Serbia in Belgrade tonight without Brobbey
sports.summary: The Netherlands play Serbia away in the Nations League today at 18:00; Brobbey has left the squad injured and Joshua Zirkzee was called up in his place.
body: Brobbey went off with an apparent hamstring problem against Germany and has returned to Sunderland, while Lutsharel Geertruida has also left the camp. Xavi has 25 players available and has left Gjivai Zechiel and Jeremie Frimpong out of the matchday squad in Belgrade.

Jurrien Timber and Kenneth Taylor, who sat in the stands on Thursday, are included this time. The Eredivisie is paused for the international break after round seven, when AZ went top with 19 points ahead of Feyenoord on 17.

sports.h3: Luna Rossa leads America's Cup Naples regatta into final day
sports.summary: Peter Burling's Luna Rossa 1 leads the AC40 Preliminary Regatta in Naples on 51 points, eight clear of Emirates Team New Zealand, with the match race final scheduled today.
body: Four fleet races were sailed on Saturday 26 September in 16 to 18 knots. Burling added a win, a sixth, a second and a third, while Nathan Outteridge recovered from an opening eighth for Emirates Team New Zealand to sit second on 43, five points ahead of Tudor Team Alinghi.

La Roche-Posay Racing Team was the fastest boat of the day, winning two races, but capsized while leading the fifth and sits seventh. The New Zealand Women and Youth crew of Jake Pye and Erica Dawson took advantage to win that race, the first win of the regatta for any Women and Youth crew.

Two more fleet races on Sunday will decide the top two, who meet in a single winner-takes-all match race. The event is the first racing on the 2027 America's Cup course, though results do not carry over to the Cup itself.

sports.h3: Light air, a capsize and a broken foot on Naples day one
sports.summary: Only two of three planned races were completed on Friday 25 September in Naples, where Team USA won the opener and the French AC40 capsized on the start line.
body: Two early attempts at Race 1 were abandoned as the breeze hovered around the AC40's 7.5-knot minimum. At the third start American Racing Challenger Team USA, steered by Harry Melges IV despite a broken foot, led from the first gate and beat Luna Rossa 1 by 18 seconds.

In Race 2 La Roche-Posay capsized seconds after the gun while trying to return after starting early, scoring no points. Burling then covered Alinghi to win by 21 seconds and lead overnight on 19 points.

sports.h3: Spain beat Australia in Geneva to book SailGP Grand Final spot
sports.summary: Diego Botin's Los Gallos won the Switzerland Sail Grand Prix on 20 September, joining the Bonds Flying Roos in the Abu Dhabi Grand Final; Dubai follows on 21 and 22 November.
body: In the final on Lake Geneva, Australia won the start but Botin reeled in Tom Slingsby's crew and took the lead, leaving the Flying Roos runners-up for the second event in a row. ROCKWOOL Racing were third after winning three of five fleet races, and the home Swiss team reached their third final of the season.

Martine Grael made her debut driving the US SailGP Team in place of the injured Taylor Canfield, after a sudden exit from Brazil. Sweden's Artemis moved into third overall, pushing the United States off the podium with two events left.

sports.h3: Musumeci outpoints Bryce Mitchell at UFC BJJ 11
sports.summary: Mikey Musumeci beat UFC featherweight Bryce Mitchell by unanimous decision in Las Vegas on 24 September, while Mason Fowler kept his title in a split draw with Nick Rodriguez.
body: Musumeci agreed not to finish with leglocks but used them to sweep and improve position, threatening with a D'Arce, a guillotine and a late armbar. Mitchell defended stubbornly for all three rounds, but the judges gave the bantamweight champion the win.

In the co-main event Rodriguez finished strongly with a mount and choke attempt, yet the light heavyweight title fight was scored a split draw, so Fowler retained the belt. Jay Rodriguez submitted Kevin Beuhring with an inverted D'Arce, and debutants Daniel Deeder and 18-year-old Mason Stritzel also won by submission.

sports.h3: ADCC 2026 data: 51% finish rate and a record for Felipe Pena
sports.summary: A BJJ Heroes analysis of the ADCC Worlds in Krakow (19 and 20 September) counted 61 submissions in 119 matches, with Felipe Pena the first to win the absolute twice.
body: Pena led the event with five finishes and took the open weight despite a serious foot injury before the tournament. The rear-naked choke remained the most common finish, while heel hooks again failed to make the top three.

Champions included Kennedy Maciel at 66kg, Magomed Dzharbaev at 77kg, home favourite Pawel Jaworski at 88kg and Victor Hugo at over 99kg. The report notes a shift toward no-gi and wrestling backgrounds and says pressure passing and lower-body takedowns remain the surest route to gold.

consumer-tech.h3: Meta Connect: $349 audio glasses, Gen 3 Ray-Bans and VR Glasses
consumer-tech.summary: At Meta Connect on 23 September, Meta launched Ray-Ban Meta Audio at $349 and Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 at $449, and previewed 100-gram VR Glasses for spring 2027 at $1,299.99.
body: Ray-Ban Meta Audio drops the camera for open-ear sound, weighs 43 grams and is rated for 12 hours of use, shipping 13 October. The camera-equipped Gen 3 adds a 12MP sensor, 3K video and up to nine hours of battery, and is on sale now.

Meta VR Glasses use micro-OLED panels at 37 pixels per degree and move the processor and battery into a pocket puck connected by an optical cable. Meta is lining up Disney+ 3D films, IMAX Enhanced certification and more than 100 live sports events a year for the device.

The company is also bringing its Muse AI agent to glasses in the coming months, and Meta Ray-Ban Display goes on sale in Canada and the UK with European preorders ahead of 13 October. FDA-cleared hearing enhancement software is due on supported glasses in the US later this year for $149.99.

consumer-tech.h3: Qualcomm splits flagship into Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Extreme
consumer-tech.summary: At Snapdragon Summit in Maui (22 to 24 September), Qualcomm launched two separate 2nm flagship chips, with prime cores reaching 5GHz on the Extreme tier.
body: This is the first time Qualcomm has released two Snapdragon 8 Elite tiers together, and executives stressed they are distinct designs rather than binned versions of one chip. The Extreme model targets phones with heavier AI, gaming and video demands, including 8K at 60fps capture.

Qualcomm says the Hexagon NPU gets 50% more shared memory, and new Adreno Matrix Cores run AI upscaling and frame generation inside the graphics pipeline. Xiaomi and Motorola showed early devices, and partners including OnePlus, OPPO and vivo are lined up.

consumer-tech.h3: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max packs 8,500mAh battery and rear screen
consumer-tech.summary: Xiaomi launched the 18 Pro (from 5,999 yuan) and 18 Pro Max (from 6,999 yuan) in China on 23 September, among the first phones on Qualcomm's new chips.
body: The 6.4-inch 18 Pro uses the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and a 7,000mAh battery, while the 6.9-inch Pro Max gets the Extreme Gen 6 and 8,500mAh. Both carry a secondary rear display with more than 100 app cards and dual 200MP Leica-branded cameras.
Xiaomi has confirmed an international launch later this year but has not given prices or regions. Reports suggest global models may ship with smaller batteries than the Chinese versions.

consumer-tech.h3: Compact Surface Pro and Laptop get Snapdragon X2 Plus from $1,149
consumer-tech.summary: Microsoft refreshed the 12-inch Surface Pro and 13-inch Surface Laptop with Snapdragon X2 Plus chips, starting at $1,149 and $1,199 and shipping 13 October.
body: Both machines drop the 8GB option and now start with 16GB of RAM, which pushes the Surface Pro's entry price up by $300 versus the old base model. The Pro gains a 25% brighter display, an optional 5G version and a new Ink Canvas pen app.
Microsoft claims 60% better graphics and 95% faster on-device AI than the previous generation. A $79.99 Surface Mouse with haptic feedback arrives on the same date.

consumer-tech.h3: Microsoft quietly retires the Copilot+ PC label
consumer-tech.summary: Surface chief Brett Ostrum confirmed on 24 September that Microsoft's 2026 Surface machines are no longer called Copilot+ PCs, even though they meet every requirement.
body: Speaking at Snapdragon Summit, Ostrum said the new devices still clear the old bar for on-device AI features but simply are not marketed under that name. Qualcomm's compute chief said the same experiences will be offered without the terminology.

Windows Central notes that PC makers have been dropping the brand for two years after the troubled Recall launch in 2024. Nvidia has also avoided the label for its upcoming RTX Spark PCs despite meeting the specification.

consumer-tech.h3: iOS 27.2 beta brings new Health app and more Siri AI languages
consumer-tech.summary: Apple's iOS 27.2 beta adds Siri AI in French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish, profiles in the TV app and a redesigned Health app, with release expected in October.
body: The skip from 27 to 27.2 exists because iOS 27.1 is reserved for the iPhone Duo, which ships on 23 October. iOS 27 itself arrived on 14 September with the Siri AI overhaul.

The new Health app splits into Insights, Longevity and Browse tabs and adds a Health age estimate, though it may not ship to everyone with 27.2. Group FaceTime also gains Dual Capture on iPhone 17 and later.

consumer-tech.h3: Pixel 11 tests Gemini 'Call for Me' for routine phone calls
consumer-tech.summary: Google began an early preview on 24 September that lets Gemini phone businesses to book, check stock or reschedule on behalf of Pixel 11 owners in the US.
body: Gemini introduces itself, waits on hold and navigates phone menus while the user watches a live transcript and can take over at any time. Examples include reserving patio seating or moving a haircut appointment.
The preview is limited to Gemini subscribers in the Phone by Google beta on the Pixel 11 range in the US. Google says it is starting small to get the experience right.

consumer-tech.h3: Pixel Watch adds cuffless blood pressure and insulin trends
consumer-tech.summary: Google started rolling out blood pressure trends, insulin resistance trends and sleep breathing metrics to Pixel Watch 3, 4 and 5 on 24 September at no extra cost.
body: Blood pressure trends passively analyse a month of pulse and motion data without a cuff, needing at least five days of wear per week. The insulin resistance feature uses Google's largest sensor foundation model, trained on more than one trillion minutes of data.
Reports appear in the Google Health app on the first day of each month, with the first arriving in early October. Fitbit Air owners with Health Premium will get the features later this year.

consumer-tech.h3: BYD's flagship Great Han EV launches 13 October with 1,008km range
consumer-tech.summary: BYD confirmed its D-segment Great Han sedan launches on 13 October, with pre-orders from 249,900 yuan (about $37,200) and CLTC range up to 1,008km.
body: The rear-drive versions use a 370kW motor and a 102.3kWh Blade Battery 2.0, while the 570kW all-wheel-drive model is rated at 880km. Flash Charging takes the pack from 10% to 70% in five minutes.
At 5,256mm long the sedan is larger than a Tesla Model S and comes standard with air suspension, rear-wheel steering and the God's Eye B driver assistance system.

consumer-tech.h3: Geely's 2.25MW charger claims to heal fast-charge battery wear
consumer-tech.summary: Geely unveiled a 2,250kW charging station in Ningbo that took a Zeekr 001 battery from 10% to 70% in 4 minutes 30 seconds, plus pulse tech it says adds up to 20% cycle life.
body: The pulse restoration system sends micro-currents to reactivate lithium that builds up on the anode during repeated fast charging, and a slow home-charging mode continues the repair overnight. An AI model co-developed with StepFun predicts battery temperature 30 seconds ahead to manage power.
Geely also announced a 6C blade battery for cheaper models that it says runs 10% cooler while charging. The 10-to-97% time of 8 minutes 40 seconds edges BYD's 1,500kW Flash Charging network.

consumer-tech.h3: Lexus TZ electric three-row SUV spotted ahead of launch
consumer-tech.summary: The 2027 Lexus TZ, the brand's first all-electric three-row SUV, was seen filming a commercial in Toronto, with up to 300 miles of range and 420hp.
body: Built on the same platform as the Toyota Highlander BEV, the TZ offers 76.96kWh and 95.82kWh packs, standard dual-motor AWD and a 3,500lb towing capacity. It charges at up to 150kW and has a native NACS port.
Lexus has not announced pricing, but Electrek expects a start in the mid-$60,000 range, about $10,000 above the Highlander BEV. Sales are expected in late 2026 or early 2027.

consumer-tech.h3: Toyota readies first fully electric Corolla
consumer-tech.summary: The next-generation Corolla, due in 2027 as a 2028 model, will add plug-in hybrid and battery-electric versions with at least 250 miles of range expected.
body: Toyota will use a heavily revised TNGA-C platform to support gas, hybrid, PHEV and EV powertrains, following the Corolla Concept shown at the Japan Mobility Show. The hybrid is expected to gain a new 1.5-litre engine that is 10% to 20% more efficient.
Car and Driver estimates the EV and PHEV will be priced around $30,000. Toyota has not yet confirmed whether the electric Corolla will be sold in the US.
